IF( (NOT(CONTAINS(Internal_Local_ID__c, "Invalid"))),
Substitute(IF(LEN(Local_Student_ID__c) < 10, LPAD(TEXT(LEN(Local_Student_ID__c)),2,"0"),
IF(AND(LEN(Local_Student_ID__c) >=10,LEN(Local_Student_ID__c) < 100), TEXT(LEN(Local_Student_ID__c)), "00")) &
LEFT( Internal_Local_ID__c , 10) & School__r.District_School_ID__c & Right( Internal_Local_ID__c , 10)," ", ""),
(IF(CONTAINS(Internal_Local_ID__c,"Invalid - Local Student ID Less Than 5 characters"), "Invalid - Local Student ID Less Than 5 characters",
IF(CONTAINS(Internal_Local_ID__c,"Invalid - Local Student ID contains spaces"), "Invalid - Local Student ID contains spaces",
IF(CONTAINS(Internal_Local_ID__c,"Invalid - Local Student ID not available for this student"), "Invalid - Local Student ID not available for this student",
IF(CONTAINS(Internal_Local_ID__c,"Invalid - Local Student ID contains scientific notation"), "Invalid - Local Student ID contains scientific notation",
"Invalid - Unknown reason"))))))
